title.narrative: UNDP - Green Recovery Programme - Crisis Response for Maneuverable Energy Generation Capacity

description.narrative: The project, supported by Norad and UNDP, focuses on the critical repair of energy infrastructure in Ukraine, with a special emphasis on maneuverable energy generation capacity. It aims to achieve this by procuring and installing hybrid gas engines that can operate on both renewable fuel and natural gas for critical infrastructure, providing training for maintenance and efficient energy management, strengthening women's leadership in the energy sector, and coordinating energy sector initiatives at the sub-national level. The goal is to ensure access to energy for up to 370,000 people in the target areas
